## Description

Models market making as a Stackelberg game where reinforcement learning agents act as leaders setting optimal bid-ask spread widths against reactive noise trader follower populations under inventory risk constraints.

## Where it may fit

High-frequency limit order book market making, volatile spread widening regimes.

## Vehicles

HFT Market Makers, Crypto Prop Trading Desks.

## Required data

Level 2/3 limit order book message feeds, trade execution logs, inventory position metrics.

## Caveats

Stackelberg equilibrium reinforcement learning training requires nested simulation environments.
